project.name: da_browser-qute
project.description: qutebrowser-based daily-driver browser with daemon-side integrations: FIDO2 passkeys via da_fido2-vault-broker, password autofill via da_autofill-rbw-rofi. Pure-config (no fork) — qutebrowser ships from nixpkgs; this project owns home-manager wiring + JSON-driven settings.

browser.comment: Upstream qutebrowser is configured via Python config.py OR via NixOS home-manager `programs.qutebrowser`. This project uses the home-manager path so the SoT is JSON + Nix, not imperative Python.

data_sources.comment: All four JSON files are read by the home-manager module at evaluation time and projected into qutebrowser's declarative options. Edit JSON, rebuild home-manager, browser picks up the new state.

release.comment: Standalone qutebrowser config bundle (config.py + quickmarks + bookmarks/urls + dashboard.html + --basedir launcher), independent of the ~6GB 37-module desktop home-manager closure. Built by `build.sh release` (nix build .#standalone), published by `build.sh gh-release` (rolling tag, --clobber on every push). Installed locally via `build.sh install-standalone`.

fido2_vault_broker.comment: WebAuthn over /dev/hidraw — qutebrowser/Chromium auto-discovers the virtual FIDO2 device when the daemon is running. No extra config needed.

autofill_rbw_rofi.comment: Password autofill via global hotkey is OS-level (handled by da_autofill-rbw-rofi). qutebrowser sees the typed keystrokes like any other window.
